security_goals: require Firebase auth for every room read/write
allow exact room-code read to authenticated clients
room host is creator auth.uid; guestUid can be claimed only once by joining uid
each user can mutate only own profile/presence/party/ready/commit/reveal/ack/endRequest
reveal allowed only after both commits exist
ack allowed only after both reveals exist
expired rooms cannot accept gameplay writes
room deletion is limited to participants and safe terminal/expired cases
after guest claim, room reads are participant-only
host profile validates correctly during initial whole-room create
party/member counts use only documented Realtime Database RuleDataSnapshot primitives
non_goals: server verification of local Save v3 ownership
automatic delayed deletion of fully orphaned rooms
server verification that COMPLETE/DISCONNECT_TIMEOUT/STALL end reason is truthful
deployment_gate: npm install succeeds for firebase-tools, firebase, @firebase/rules-unit-testing
Realtime Database emulator starts with database.rules.json
school/shared-NAT anonymous auth burst test passes

test_matrix.case: authenticated valid 8-char-code host create with host profile
host create using invalid/short room code
authenticated exact secret room read before guest claim
first guest claims guestUid with own uid
third-party exact-room read after guest claim
third party writes participant party/action path
owner writes valid party before ready
owner writes noncontiguous moveIds or bad memberCount
guest writes profile, nonce, valid party and ready
set ACTIVE after both ready + guest nonce
participant deletes FINISHED/ABORTED room; nonparticipant delete denied

$roomCode..read: auth !== null && data.exists() && (!data.child('guestUid').exists() || auth.uid === data.child('hostUid').val() || auth.uid === data.child('guestUid').val())
$roomCode..write: auth !== null && ((!data.exists() && newData.exists() && newData.child('hostUid').val() === auth.uid && newData.child('status').val() === 'WAITING') || (!newData.exists() && data.exists() && ((auth.uid === data.child('hostUid').val() && data.child('status').val() === 'WAITING') || ((auth.uid === data.child('hostUid').val() || auth.uid === data.child('guestUid').val()) && (data.child('status').val() === 'FINISHED' || data.child('status').val() === 'ABORTED' || data.child('expiresAt').val() <= now)))))

status..write: auth !== null && (auth.uid === root.child('rooms').child($roomCode).child('hostUid').val() || auth.uid === root.child('rooms').child($roomCode).child('guestUid').val()) && ((data.val() === 'WAITING' && newData.val() === 'ACTIVE' && root.child('rooms').child($roomCode).child('guestUid').exists() && root.child('rooms').child($roomCode).child('guestNonce').exists() && root.child('rooms').child($roomCode).child('ready').child(root.child('rooms').child($roomCode).child('hostUid').val()).val() === true && root.child('rooms').child($roomCode).child('ready').child(root.child('rooms').child($roomCode).child('guestUid').val()).val() === true && (root.child('rooms').child($roomCode).child('expiresAt').val() > now)) || (data.val() === 'WAITING' && newData.val() === 'ABORTED') || (data.val() === 'ACTIVE' && newData.val() === 'FINISHED' && root.child('rooms').child($roomCode).child('endRequests').child(auth.uid).child('reason').val() === 'COMPLETE') || (data.val() === 'ACTIVE' && newData.val() === 'ABORTED' && root.child('rooms').child($roomCode).child('endRequests').child(auth.uid).exists() && root.child('rooms').child($roomCode).child('endRequests').child(auth.uid).child('reason').val() !== 'COMPLETE'))

$uid..write: auth !== null && auth.uid === $uid && (auth.uid === root.child('rooms').child($roomCode).child('hostUid').val() || auth.uid === root.child('rooms').child($roomCode).child('guestUid').val()) && root.child('rooms').child($roomCode).child('status').val() === 'WAITING' && root.child('rooms').child($roomCode).child('ready').child($uid).val() !== true && (root.child('rooms').child($roomCode).child('expiresAt').val() > now)

auth !== null && auth.uid === $uid && (auth.uid === root.child('rooms').child($roomCode).child('hostUid').val() || auth.uid === root.child('rooms').child($roomCode).child('guestUid').val()) && root.child('rooms').child($roomCode).child('status').val() === 'WAITING' && root.child('rooms').child($roomCode).child('parties').child($uid).exists() && data.val() !== true && newData.val() === true && (root.child('rooms').child($roomCode).child('expiresAt').val() > now)

$uid..validate: newData.hasChildren(['kind','slot','nonce','submittedAt']) && newData.child('kind').isString() && newData.child('slot').isNumber() && newData.child('nonce').isString() && newData.child('nonce').val().matches(/^[0-9a-f]{32}$/) && newData.child('submittedAt').isNumber() && ((newData.child('kind').val() === 'move' && newData.child('slot').val() >= 0 && newData.child('slot').val() <= 3) || (newData.child('kind').val() === 'switch' && newData.child('slot').val() >= 0 && newData.child('slot').val() <= 5 && newData.child('slot').val() < root.child('rooms').child($roomCode).child('parties').child($uid).child('memberCount').val()) || (newData.child('kind').val() === 'forfeit' && newData.child('slot').val() === -1))

newData.hasChildren(['reason','submittedAt']) && newData.child('reason').isString() && (newData.child('reason').val() === 'CANCEL' || newData.child('reason').val() === 'FORFEIT' || newData.child('reason').val() === 'DISCONNECT_TIMEOUT' || newData.child('reason').val() === 'DESYNC' || newData.child('reason').val() === 'INVALID_REVEAL' || newData.child('reason').val() === 'STALL' || newData.child('reason').val() === 'VERSION_MISMATCH' || newData.child('reason').val() === 'COMPLETE') && newData.child('submittedAt').isNumber()
